Author: Vivek Varma
Bench: Vivek Varma

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 79 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 5085 of 2021 Applicant :- Moti Lal Jaiswal Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Kumar Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Deepak Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manuraj Singh, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant to quash the Non-Bailable-Warrant as well as proceeding under Section 82 Cr.P.C. order dated 18.11.2020 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sant Kabir Nagar in Complaint Case No. 1917 of 2008 (State Vs.
Moti Lal Jaiswal), Under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Dhanghata, District Sant Kabir Nagar.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sant Kabir Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Police Station Dhanghata, District Sant Kabir Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is about 70 years of age and earlier he was granted bail by the competent Court on 20.02.2010 but due to some unavoidable circumstances he could not appear before the trial Court on subsequent dates.
Hence non-bailable warrant has been issued.

He submits the reasons on account of which the applicant failed to appear before the Moti Lal Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 25 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148817450/

entities.text: Moti Lal Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 trial court were beyond his control and the applicant has every intention to appear before the Court concerned and participate in the trial.
Counsel for the applicant further submits that liberty may be accorded to the applicant for filing an application for recall of order issuing non-bailable warrant.
The prayer for quashing the order issuing non-bailable warrant is refused.

However, it is provided that if the applicant files an application for recall of the order issuing non-bailable warrant within a period of three weeks from today, the said application shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in accordance with law.
For a period of three weeks from today, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.

In case, the applicant does not file the application before the Court below within the aforesaid period,
coercive action shall be taken against him.
It is made clear that no application seeking extension of time shall be entertained, if this order is not complied within the aforesaid period.
With the aforesaid observations, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 25.3.2021 Lbm/-
